composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Sculpt a small pangolin in warm ivory porcelain, half curled so its raised nose peeks above the rounded tail. Reduce the scales to six broad overlapping forms with gently pooled celadon glaze at their edges. Give it tiny attentive eyes and a calm, friendly posture. Photograph the object against pale sage with soft side light, a delicate grounding shadow, and generous space around its unusual silhouette. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
